resource_policy.lean_role: bounded proof, disproof, and example probes; no full rebuild
resource_policy.lean_memory_note: 5 GiB starts Lean but Mathlib probe compilation exits 139; use 12 GiB for one globally serialized Mathlib probe while keeping all other lanes light

schedule.deliverable: at least 8 genuine representations and 10 decisive mechanisms per problem
adversarial paper, Python, or bounded-Lean kill tests with evidence
at most 3 survivors and one strongest decisive lemma per viable problem
cross-agent blind reconstruction where a lemma passes the deepening gate
validated campaign states, exact claim ledger, promotion or freeze decisions

lane_priority.strategy: strong warm restart; endpoint-reserve and Hall-type mechanisms
warm restart; growing-c potential and adaptive feasibility bridge
cold representation search; exponent-changing routes only
medium-cold restart; full-row and arbitrary-host information

stop_rules: Do not rebuild Lean or Mathlib.
Do not run more than one heavy probe per lane.
Kill a probe on timeout or memory-limit failure and retain that outcome as operational evidence only.
Do not weaken a mathematical gate to fit the clock.
Unused time from a frozen lane is reassigned to the strongest surviving lane.
